property.name: note
property.value:
Parameters in use: Intensity - Essentially a phase counter, you can tie the different intensity changes (0, 1, 2, 3) to various points of the dialogue or fight as needed.
0.00 - Loops intro piano (can use during the dialogue sequences as player bonds with minima in the black void)
0.01-0.99 - gradually introduces background elements into the piano loop to transition into next segment. the parameter has a set seek-speed so even if you change the value in whole integers, it will still undergo a gradual fade.
1.00 - Loops second half of intro, repeat until you feel the track should properly begin
2.00 - Main track start, at this level it repeats without going into the climax section
3.00 - Climax, transitions musically from any point in the previous section, so the music is still somewhat adaptive to the player. Loops normally through the whole form.
